live_schema_metadata.method: Read-only OpenAPI GETs; modern non-JWT keys used only as apikey headers; no RPC call or data write
live_schema_metadata.limit: OpenAPI is cache/config/privilege dependent. Presence/absence does not prove current function implementation, table RLS policies or cross-account isolation. Earlier configured-key401 with a non-JWT Bearer is not evidence of a broken credential.

live_public_read_and_auth.method: Read-only SDK table HEAD and public auth-settings GET; no account creation, mail, RPC, data write or key output
live_public_read_and_auth.limits: Endpoint-specific OpenAPI401 does not establish an invalid key. A zero anonymous row count is not a full RLS/role/function-grant audit; settings do not prove email delivery.
